prompt:
Desktop web application screen, 16:9, LIGHT theme, premium modern fintech product UI, flat design with crisp detail (not a photograph, no hands, no desk, no perspective). Product: "Valuta": salaries agreed in pesos paid in USDC at the rate that was live on payday. Layout:
1) Slim top bar on cool white (#F6F8F9): wordmark "Valuta" at left, links "Payrolls", "New payroll", "Rate lookup", a small live indicator "Arc mainnet · block 27,861,402" with a pulsing petrol dot, and a deep petrol (#0B4F6C) "Connect wallet" button.
2) LEFT 42%: the claim set large in a confident grotesk, ink #0E1B26: "Salaries agreed in pesos, paid in USDC at the rate that was live on payday, however late it settles." Under it, a small live countdown chip in amber: "Payroll 2 · next value date in 01:59:41".
3) RIGHT 58%, the hero: ONE large PAYSLIP printed as a security document on crisp white paper, with a faint fine petrol guilloché line pattern across its background and a perforated top edge.
   - Header row in small caps: "VALUTA PAYSLIP · No. 01 of 20 · PAYROLL 1".
   - A large rubber-stamp impression in petrol ink, rotated -3 degrees: "VALUE 15 OCT 2026 · 14:00 UTC".
   - Lines: "Salary MXN 1.00" · "Rate MXN/USD 0.05389760 (≈ 18.55 MXN per USD) · Chainlink round 292, published 13:50".
   - The paid amount very large in a monospaced face: "0.053897 USDC".
   - Beneath it, struck through in grey: "0.053567 at the 25 Oct rate it settled on".
   - A round embossed guilloché seal with the words "RATE HELD" in petrol.
   - Three small check lines: "Round 292 was live at 14:00", "Round 293 came at 14:06", "10 minutes old, inside 25 h".
   - Footer in monospace: "settled 25 Oct 13:59 by 0xe5CA…aBC3, not the employer · tx 0x82ff…38b7 · Verify on Arc".
4) Full-width at the bottom: a thin horizontal timeline with round ticks 291, 292 (ringed petrol), 293, a payday stamp marker at 14:00, a break mark, and a carbon-blue settlement mark "25 Oct". Under it a row of eleven small payslip coupons "01" to "11", each with a tiny petrol "HELD" stamp; coupon 01 is selected.
Palette: cool white #F6F8F9 ground, paper #FFFFFF, ink #0E1B26, petrol #0B4F6C, carbon blue #2E3F8F for filled figures, amber #B7791F only for the countdown. No gradients, no glow, no dark mode. Crisp legible text.
